proposed_target_rule: Exactly one userns+pidns+last-NSpid=selfpid match in unit cgroup.procs. Namespace-only count informational. No arbitrary target selection.
temporal_rule: Target PID and stat field22 starttime equal before/after. Userns and pidns equal before/after and equal self-record. NSpid first equals hostPID, last equals selfPID, at least2elements. Starttime within launch/readiness CLOCK_BOOTTIME tick bracket.
clock_observations: Root records CLOCK_BOOTTIME and SC_CLK_TCK at launch and newline readiness, converting by floor. Reader launcher records own userns/pidns before exact exec chain.
full_stat_string_equality: NOT proposed; both Opus source reviews specify stable PID/starttime, not volatile full stat fields. Please ratify authoritative rule.
completion_rule: Reader and subject exit0 only; no errors, traceback, missing output, ambiguity or nonempty stderr; no timeout acceptance.
identity_rule: Init-ns reader/walker/launcher identity tuples match, reader pidns initial as recorded in launcher. Target init-read uid/gid map row1000 1000 1; Uid/Gid1000x4; Groups exact27 100 986 1000 1001; CapInh/Prm/Eff/Amb0; NNP1; deny; self overflow pattern retained.
environment_rule: INVOCATION_ID expected/informational, value not compared/emitted; absent underscore benign; original forbidden keys remain STOP.
